data.name: Thorvald
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse, Thorvald means 'Thor's protector' or 'Thor's warrior'. Thor was the Norse god of thunder, strength, and protection. The name reflects the power and courage of the Norse gods.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Norse god Thor, symbolizing strength, protection, and bravery.

data.cultural_impact: The name Thorvald has its roots in the rich cultural heritage of the Norse mythology. It is a reminder of a time when the world was believed to be governed by powerful gods, and men sought their protection and guidance in their daily lives. The name carries a sense of strength, courage, and the power of nature, which continues to inspire awe and reverence.
data.spiritual_significance: Thorvald is a name that embodies the concept of divine protection. It is a reminder that, no matter how challenging the world may be, we are not alone. Just as Thor protected the Norse people, so can a higher power protect and guide us through life's trials and tribulations. The name encourages us to call upon that power and strength when we need it most.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Thorvald in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Thorvald, which means "Thunder wolf". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
